Get creative to earn this year’s eerie-sistible spectral profile badge! How do I take part in this resurrection? Pick an old deviation from your gallery. This can be one of your first-ever sketches, a WIP, or just a piece that deserves another moment in the moonlight. Reimagine it in ghostly form. Suggesting Daily Deviations Just Got Easier! by moonbeam13, journal

Suggesting Daily Deviations Just Got Easier!

Aug 13, 2025
We’re making it simpler than ever to share the amazing art you discover with the Community team! Until now, suggesting a Daily Deviation often meant figuring out who to send a Note to, making sure it went to the right person, and hoping it landed in the right inbox. While we’ll still happily accept Notes, there’s now a faster and more accessible way to get your suggestion seen by the whole DD team. The New DD Suggestion Form Just fill out this form, and you’re done! 💡 Pro tip: Bookmark the link so you can suggest whenever inspiration strikes! What you’ll need: A link to the artwork you’re suggesting The category the artwork belongs in (the form will guide you) (Optional) A quick note about why you love it (Optional) Your DeviantArt username That’s it! No guessing, no searching -- your suggestion will go straight into our shared list for the DD team to review. Why use the form? It’s faster - no waiting for the right person to check their Notes It’s accessible -

Celebrating Deviousness - October 2025

Oct 1, 2025
The Deviousness Award is given to one deviant each month in recognition of their exemplary contributions to DeviantArt and its community and has been a long-standing tradition since DeviantArt’s early years. @Estheryu is the recipient of October 2025’s Deviousness Award, so please join us in congratulating her! With nearly two decades of creativity shared on DeviantArt, @Estheryu has become a beloved figure whose work continues to inspire and delight. Her gallery is filled with whimsical watercolors, expressive sketches, and vibrant digital pieces, each infused with charm, detail, and heartfelt storytelling. Equally inspiring is her dedication to the community. From participating in groups and organizing events to supporting fellow artists, @Estheryu embodies the spirit of connection that makes DeviantArt thrive. Her artistic journey, from her earliest sketches to her career as a full-time manga artist, is a testament to perseverance, passion, and the joy of creation. We are

Share your favourite fan art, characters, or moments from the series, and let’s keep the spirit of Downton alive together!
